rationale: 固定時間exitではTRAIN上の点期待値が正でも分散とLCBが悪い。entry族を変えず、損失尾を限定し利益を伸ばすBE/trail/structure exitを独立軸として検証する。
source_contract: same archived OANDA M5 BA JPY pairs and pre-2026-06-30 holdout boundary as strategy_expansion_preregister_v1

exit_policies.TIME_24: exit at next 24th consecutive M5 open
exit_policies.BRACKET_1ATR_1_5ATR: entry-frozen ATR14, SL=1 ATR, TP=1.5 ATR
exit_policies.BRACKET_1ATR_2ATR: entry-frozen ATR14, SL=1 ATR, TP=2 ATR
exit_policies.BE_AFTER_1ATR_TP2ATR: initial 1 ATR SL and 2 ATR TP; after favorable 1 ATR wick, entry-price stop becomes active from next bar
exit_policies.ATR_TRAIL: initial 1 ATR SL; after completed close gains 1 ATR, 1.5 ATR ratchet becomes active next bar; time exit at 24 bars
exit_policies.SMA_DETERIORATION: initial 1 ATR SL; three completed adverse SMA20 slopes trigger next-bar side-correct open exit; time exit at 24 bars
exit_policies.STRUCTURE_BREAK: initial 1 ATR SL; completed close beyond prior 6-bar structure triggers next-bar side-correct open exit; time exit at 24 bars

execution.first_touch: LONG uses OANDA bid high/low; SHORT uses ask low/high
execution.gap_stop: worse side-correct open; gap TP improvement capped at target
execution.slippage: additional adverse 0.5 contemporaneous spread at entry and exit

split_and_gates.train: n>=20, expectancy>0, PF>1, bootstrap LCB>0, and both lookback 24/48 pass for same pair/family/session/exit
split_and_gates.validation: exact TRAIN plateau, n>=10, expectancy>0, PF>1, bootstrap LCB>0
split_and_gates.multi_window: 32d and 64d validation signs both positive when eligible
